name: How often should I inspect my siding flashing for potential issues?

mainEntity.name: How often should I inspect my siding flashing for potential issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is recommended to visually inspect your siding flashing at least once a year, ideally in the spring or fall. After severe weather events, such as heavy rains or strong winds common in the Pacifica and surrounding Bay Area, an additional inspection is advisable. Pay close attention to areas around windows, doors, chimneys, and roof-to-wall junctions. Early detection of minor issues like rust, gaps, or bent sections can prevent them from escalating into major water damage problems, saving you significant repair costs in the long run.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inspect annually, preferably in spring or fall, and after severe weather. Early detection prevents major water damage.
